name: etech-kafka-connect-http
title: Etech Kafka Connect HTTP Sink
description: Open-source HTTP sink connector for Apache Kafka Connect. Full REST verb coverage (GET / POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE), Mustache-style templating, OAuth2 client_credentials and Basic auth, exponential-backoff retries, optional Kafka response reporting and native DLQ integration.

support.summary: Community-supported. Open an issue on GitHub.
